import os,sys,json,random,tempfile,subprocess,ctypes,shutil
r=random.Random(26080903)
N=8000
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 cfile=os.path.join(td,'b.c'); so=os.path.join(td,'b.so')
 open(cfile,'w').write(r'''#include <stdint.h>
int allow(uint8_t base_ok,uint8_t origin_ok,int amount,int max_call,int consumed,int total){
 return base_ok && origin_ok && amount>=0 && amount<=max_call && consumed>=0 && consumed+amount<=total;
}
''')
 gcc=shutil.which('gcc') or shutil.which('clang')
 cp=subprocess.run([gcc,'-shared','-fPIC','-O2',cfile,'-o',so],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if cp.returncode: print(json.dumps({'status':'compile_fail','stderr':cp.stderr[:300]})); raise SystemExit
 lib=ctypes.CDLL(so); f=lib.allow; f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint8,ctypes.c_uint8,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int]; f.restype=ctypes.c_int
 cases=[]; refs=[]
 for k in range(N):
  total=r.randint(20,300); consumed=r.randint(0,total); max_call=r.randint(1,60); amount=r.randint(0,80)
  origin_ok=r.random()>.18; base_ok=r.random()>.15
  c={'base_ok':base_ok,'origin_ok':origin_ok,'amount':amount,'max_call':max_call,'consumed':consumed,'total':total}
  ref=base_ok and origin_ok and amount<=max_call and consumed+amount<=total
  cases.append(c); refs.append(ref)
 ffi=[bool(f(int(c['base_ok']),int(c['origin_ok']),c['amount'],c['max_call'],c['consumed'],c['total'])) for c in cases]
 child=r'''import sys,json
for line in sys.stdin:
 c=json.loads(line); ok=bool(c['base_ok'] and c['origin_ok'] and c['amount']<=c['max_call'] and c['consumed']+c['amount']<=c['total']); print('1' if ok else '0')
'''
 pp=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',child],input=''.join(json.dumps(c,separators=(',',':'))+'\n' for c in cases),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
 ipc=[x=='1' for x in pp.stdout.splitlines()]
 # targeted mutations
 m=2000; origin_false=budget_reset_false=0
 for k in range(m):
  # origin-laundering target: everything valid except untrusted origin
  c={'base_ok':True,'origin_ok':False,'amount':1,'max_call':10,'consumed':0,'total':100}
  ref=False; mutant=bool(c['base_ok'] and c['amount']<=c['max_call'] and c['consumed']+c['amount']<=c['total'])
  origin_false += (not ref) and mutant
  # aggregate target: call individually valid but cumulative budget exceeded; reset mutant forgets consumed
  total=100; consumed=r.randint(91,100); amount=r.randint(10,20); max_call=25
  ref=consumed+amount<=total
  mutant=amount<=max_call and amount<=total
  budget_reset_false += (not ref) and mutant
 print(json.dumps({'experiment':'EXP-CC-LANE-B-ORIGIN-BUDGET-003','cases':N,'reference_allow':sum(refs),'reference_deny':N-sum(refs),'c_ffi_mismatches':sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(refs,ffi)),'json_ipc_mismatches':sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(refs,ipc)),'child_exit':pp.returncode,'targeted_origin_cases':m,'origin_check_removed_false_accepts':origin_false,'targeted_budget_cases':m,'consumed_state_reset_false_accepts':budget_reset_false,'c_compiler':gcc,'claim_boundary':'constructed cross-boundary origin/aggregate-budget mechanism test; not full production capability ledger'},sort_keys=True))
